title: Fixed Points
description: Where a system stops changing: an equilibrium. Newton found them by guessing, then sliding down the tangent, again and again.

puzzle.goal: To find the square root of a, guess x, then average x with a/x. Write the better guess X.
puzzle.name: Babylonian method
puzzle.ask: Find X for a = @{a} and x = @{x}.
puzzle.method: It is Newton's method for x² − a = 0: x − (x² − a)/(2x). Its fixed point is √a, and it doubles the digits each time.
